description: Dear Friends and Neighbors,There are so many reasons to be thankful this year, and I hope as you gather with your family and friends over this Thanksgiving weekend, you too will remember all of the special moments in your life that have made you thankful. I am grateful for my friends and family who are always there to support me, and as your elected state representative, I am thankful to be able to represent you and our community at the State House.
